scenes.title: Opening Theme Song
scenes.summary: Opening title sequence for Episode 13 of Behind the Scenes.

scenes.title: The Publisher Does Not Even Have Clean Rights
scenes.summary: Pouring drinks undercover, Bu Xiaogu flatters Wang Er into boasting that the publisher suing Xingtian never paid the original songwriter—and that he sprung the trap knowing nobody could find her.

scenes.title: Stop Digging Up Those Old Scores
scenes.summary: Furious on his friend's behalf, Wen Simo demands Chun Yuqiao's signature to grill Luo Lin on live television, until Yuqiao begs him not to reopen old wounds at this fragile moment with Xin Huimei.

scenes.title: The Person You Never Name Is Who You Protect
scenes.summary: Braving Chun Yuqiao's temper, Bu Xiaogu reveals that the publisher's contract is legally void, deduces Yuqiao knows where the reclusive songwriter lives because he protects those he never names, and heads abroad.

scenes.title: Persuading the Reclusive Songwriter Overseas
scenes.summary: Visiting the reclusive songwriter in her quiet island retreat, Bu Xiaogu appeals to her bond with Chun Yuqiao to win signed authorization and rushes home on a borrowed private jet.

scenes.title: Paper Receipts and Signed Authorization
scenes.summary: When the foreign group demands Xingtian replace Chun Yuqiao with Wang Er, Stella and Kaiwen stall for hours, unearth Wang Er's handwritten filing slip in paper archives, and greet Bu Xiaogu's triumphant return.

scenes.title: Turning the Tables and Gifted New Music
scenes.summary: Wen Simo exposes the publisher's breach on air, Chun Yuqiao announces a gifted new song from the songwriter while challenging the foreign representative's arrogance, and Xiaogu stays behind to read an original show plan.
scenes.location: broadcast studio and Xingtian conference room

scenes.title: Every Singer Deserves Her Own Signature Song
scenes.summary: In Episode Two of Twelve Singers, Xin Huimei declines a second duet so Bai Yang can shine solo on the songwriter's gifted piece, and Chun Yuqiao grants Bai Yang permanent singing rights.

scenes.title: Cherishing the Present and an Original Blueprint
scenes.summary: Chun Yuqiao offers to tell Xin Huimei everything about his past, Bu Xiaogu visits Huimei so no shadow remains between them, and Xiaogu marvels over Yuqiao's confidential original show proposal.
scenes.location: Xin Huimei's home and Xingtian desk

scenes.title: Promoted Two Grades to Senior Producer
scenes.summary: Publicly commended for resolving the copyright crisis, Bu Xiaogu jumps two pay grades to senior producer alongside Kaiwen and Xingzi—who promptly introduces thirty-seven internal rules.

scenes.title: This Is Not a Road With a Turnaround
scenes.summary: Pitching his original survival concept to Xingtian's chairwoman despite steep opportunity costs, Chun Yuqiao vows it can surpass Twelve Singers—just before Kaiwen reports Xin Huimei is three hours late to rehearsal.

scenes.title: Talent Executives Tour Xingtian Ahead of Investment
scenes.summary: Xin Huimei's manager welcomes a rival talent executive touring Xingtian ahead of a major corporate equity deal.

scenes.title: Stage Celebration and First Time Late
scenes.summary: Using the delayed rehearsal to throw Bu Xiaogu a stage celebration, Chun Yuqiao teases Xiaogu after she fangirls over a visiting executive's movie idol, right before an apologetic Xin Huimei arrives.
